# macro.thermal_width { #clerq.macro.thermal_width }

```python
macro.thermal_width(temperature, mass, wavelength)
```

The ``thermal_width`` of ``velocity_classes`` for a vapor.

The Doppler weights in clerq are ``exp(-(delta / w)^2)`` with ``w = u /
lambda`` and ``u = sqrt(2 k_B T / m)`` the most probable speed.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                   | Default    |
|-------------|--------|-------------------------------|------------|
| temperature | float  | Temperature, in kelvin.       | _required_ |
| mass        | float  | Atomic mass, in amu.          | _required_ |
| wavelength  | float  | Transition wavelength, in nm. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description   |
|--------|--------|---------------|
|        | float  | ``w`` in MHz. |
